core.title: Club lane rate rise at Parkside Pool
core.setting: The duty manager at Parkside Swimming Pool whose assistant tracks lane bookings, swimming-lesson registers, and maintenance checks

events.text: Every lane booking, lesson register entry and maintenance check goes into the duty manager's system on the same day it happens. Nothing waits until the end of the week.
Club lane hire at Parkside is charged at 18 pounds per lane per hour. Every quote, booking confirmation and invoice sent to a swim club must use this rate.
No price or rate on a club's confirmed booking may be changed without that club's coach agreeing first. This applies to every club we deal with.
Any maintenance order above 250 pounds needs Tom Reilly's sign-off before it is placed.

The main pool holds eight lanes. Lanes 1 and 2 have shallow steps and are kept for lessons on weekday mornings; the pool is quietest before 08:00 on weekdays, which suits the weekly maintenance check.
Confirming that Parkside's main pool will host the county gala on Saturday 14 November 2026. The small pool stays open to the public as usual that day.
Otters Masters would like our usual Thursday 8pm slot, three lanes, for a November block of four sessions on 5, 12, 19 and 26 November.
Seahorses would like Tuesdays 7:00 to 8:30pm, two lanes, through the autumn.
Nova Swim Club wants Wednesdays 7 to 8pm, two lanes, for a September to October block of nine sessions starting 2 September.
Quote for six drums of chlorine at 40 pounds per drum, delivered to the Parkside plant room.
Ordered six drums of chlorine from Clearline at 240 pounds in total - under the 250 pound limit, so no sign-off was needed.
Chlorine drums delivered to the plant room. Thanks for the order.
Confirmed Nova Swim Club's September to October block: Wednesdays 7 to 8pm, two lanes, at 18 pounds per lane per hour, nine sessions from 2 September to 28 October.
Thanks - Nova confirms the Wednesday evening block. See you in September.
Called in a report: the lane ropes on lanes 3 and 4 are fraying. Clearline quoted 420 pounds to replace the full set.
Placed the lane rope replacement order with Clearline for 420 pounds, with Tom Reilly's sign-off as the amount is above 250 pounds.
Sign-off given for the lane rope order. Keep the invoice with the plant maintenance file.
Scheduled the weekly maintenance check for Mondays at 07:00 from 7 September onwards, assigned to Sam, since the pool is quietest before 08:00 on weekdays.
Our numbers are up this season - we'll keep the two Tuesday lanes right through the autumn.
Staff meeting notes: autumn lesson registers filling up; gala planning starts next month; small pool boiler service booked.
The block is going well. We'll talk about winter slots nearer the time.
Confirmed Seahorses' October block: Tuesdays 7:00 to 8:30pm, two lanes, at 18 pounds per lane per hour, sessions on 6, 13, 20 and 27 October.
Booked extra lifeguard cover for the county gala day on Saturday 14 November, 09:00 to 17:00, assigned to Jordan.
Confirmed Otters Masters' November block: Thursdays 8 to 9pm, three lanes, at 18 pounds per lane per hour, sessions on 5, 12, 19 and 26 November.
Confirmed Seahorses' November block: Tuesdays 7:00 to 8:30pm, two lanes, at 18 pounds per lane per hour, sessions on 3, 10, 17 and 24 November.
Prepared Otters Masters' invoice for their November block: four sessions, three lanes, one hour each, at 18 pounds per lane per hour, giving 216 pounds in total. Saved as a draft ready to send.
Autumn reminder for all staff: club lane hire stands at 18 pounds per lane per hour. Quotes and invoices to clubs must use this figure.

Priya - following the council's energy review, club lane hire at Parkside rises to 22 pounds per lane per hour from 1 November 2026. The old 18 pound rate still applies to bookings for sessions taking place before 1 November. The rule that a club's coach must agree before any price on a confirmed booking is changed still stands. Please bring the club paperwork in line.
Send Otters Masters their November invoice by 31 October.
Dana - one-off lane rental for the county gala weekend is 20 pounds per lane per hour. That's separate from the club block rate and only covers the gala weekend.
Otters are all set for the November Thursdays. Please send the invoice over whenever it's ready.
Staff meeting notes: gala prep on track, setup begins Friday 13 November; lesson registers checked; small pool boiler service completed.
Monday checks going well. The new lane ropes on lanes 3 and 4 are in and bedded in.
Pool open as normal this week. Gala setup begins Friday 13 November; the main pool closes for the gala on Saturday 14 November.

Seahorses' November block (EV-3) is equally affected, but its rate sits behind Ben Osei's consent under the coach-consent rule, so it must stay as it is with a consent request.
